summary.text: Mike Amyx is a Democratic state representative who has represented Kansas House District 45 since 2019 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. The owner of Amyx Barber Shop, he previously served as a Lawrence city commissioner and mayor and as a Douglas County commissioner.

paragraphs.text: Amyx, as of February 2020, lived in Lawrence, Kansas.
His career experience includes owning Amyx Barber Shop.
He was elected to serve as Lawrence City Commissioner, mayor of Lawrence, Douglas County Commissioner, and chair of the Douglas County Commission.
Amyx assumed office in the Kansas House in 2019.

During the 2025-2026 session he served on the Appropriations, Calendar and Printing, General Government Budget, and House Legislative Budget committees, and as ranking minority member of the House Interstate Cooperation and Higher Education Budget committees.
